---
title: "Observable JavaScript: `{ojs2}`"
---

`{ojs2}` cells are Observable JavaScript, the language of Observable Notebooks
2.0: plain JavaScript where top-level declarations are reactive and
`display()` shows values. They compile with Notebook Kit's `js` mode.

## Declarations and `display()`

```{ojs2}
const temperatures = [12, 15, 19, 23, 21, 17];
const mean = temperatures.reduce((a, b) => a + b) / temperatures.length;
display(`Mean: ${mean.toFixed(1)}°`);
```

## Inputs with `view()`

```{ojs2}
const threshold = view(Inputs.range([10, 25], {value: 18, step: 1, label: "Threshold"}));
```

```{ojs2}
const warm = temperatures.filter((t) => t >= threshold);
display(`${warm.length} of ${temperatures.length} days at or above ${threshold}°`);
```

## Plot

```{ojs2}
display(
  Plot.plot({
    height: 200,
    marks: [
      Plot.barY(temperatures.map((t, day) => ({day, t})), {x: "day", y: "t", fill: (d) => d.t >= threshold ? "tomato" : "steelblue"}),
      Plot.ruleY([threshold], {stroke: "black"}),
    ],
  }),
);
```

## npm imports

```{ojs2}
import {median} from "npm:d3-array";
display(`Median: ${median(temperatures)}°`);
```
